name: Cash Account
definition: Account to or from which a cash entry is made.

CashAccountType.name: Cash Account Type
CashAccountType.definition: Specifies the nature, or use, of the cash account.

Level.name: Level
Level.definition: Defines the level of an account within the account hierarchy.

SettlementCurrency.name: Settlement Currency
SettlementCurrency.definition: Specifies the currency used for settlement, if different from the account currency.

RelatedInvestmentAccount.name: Related Investment Account
RelatedInvestmentAccount.definition: Investment account for which a cash branch is specified.

CashEntry.name: Cash Entry
CashEntry.definition: Record of the cash movements into or out of a cash account. It is derived from the association between Account and Entry.

CashBalance.name: Cash Balance
CashBalance.definition: Overall position representing the net debits and credits in an account at a specific point in time. It is derived from the association between Account and Balance.

PaymentPartyRole.name: Payment Party Role
PaymentPartyRole.definition: Specifies each role linked to a payment and using a specific cash account in the payment context.

RelatedCreditStandingOrder.name: Related Credit Standing Order
RelatedCreditStandingOrder.definition: Instruction given by an account holder to an account servicer to make regular transfers on given dates to the same beneficiary.

RelatedDebitStandingOrder.name: Related Debit Standing Order
RelatedDebitStandingOrder.definition: Instruction given by an account holder to an account servicer to make regular transfers on given dates to the same beneficiary.

CashAccountContract.name: Cash Account Contract
CashAccountContract.definition: Contract which manages the account. It is derived from the relation between AccountContract and Account.

RelatedCorporateActionElection.name: Related Corporate Action Election
RelatedCorporateActionElection.definition: Election process which uses specific cash accounts.

Charges.name: Charges
Charges.definition: Specifies the charges which are debited from the account.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Tax charged on a cash account.

RelatedSettlementInstruction.name: Related Settlement Instruction
RelatedSettlementInstruction.definition: Settlement process which uses specific cash accounts.

CashSettlementPartyRole.name: Cash Settlement Party Role
CashSettlementPartyRole.definition: Specifies each role linked to a payment settlement and using a specific cash account in the payment context.

UltimateObligor.name: Ultimate Obligor
UltimateObligor.definition: Party for which different types of cash accounts are specified.

RelatedPaymentCard.name: Related Payment Card
RelatedPaymentCard.definition: Payment card for which an account is specified.

SecuritiesPartyRole.name: Securities Party Role
SecuritiesPartyRole.definition: Specifies the role which uses a cash account.

RelatedInvoiceFinancingPartyRole.name: Related Invoice Financing Party Role
RelatedInvoiceFinancingPartyRole.definition: Specifies each role using a specific account in the context of invoice financing.

RelatedCommercialTrade.name: Related Commercial Trade
RelatedCommercialTrade.definition: Commercial trade for which a purchase account is specified.

ReportedMovements.name: Reported Movements
ReportedMovements.definition: Provides statistical information on the number of movements and their value for a particular account.

ClosedAccountContract.name: Closed Account Contract
ClosedAccountContract.definition: Contract which specifies the cash account to/from which the balance of a closed account must be transferred.

AccountLink.name: Account Link
AccountLink.definition: Defines the link between a cash account and a securities account.

CashStandingOrder.name: Cash Standing Order
CashStandingOrder.definition: Standing order which applies on a specific account.

Cheque.name: Cheque
Cheque.definition: Cheques drawn on a cash account.

CashAccountService.name: Cash Account Service
CashAccountService.definition: Services linked to the cash account and specified in the cash account contract. It is derived from the association between Account and AccountService.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Payment for which an account is specified.

Commission.name: Commission
Commission.definition: Amount of money due to a party as compensation for a service.

RelatedAccountVerification.name: Related Account Verification
RelatedAccountVerification.definition: Information related to the verification of an account validity.
